name: Ferienwohnung Thaler Georg
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Thaler Georg is located in a quiet district of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland, near the German border. The surroundings are characterized by extensive forests and the peaks of the Brandenberger Alpen. The apartment offers a well-equipped kitchen, separate bedrooms, and its own garden area. In summer, the Thiersee with its lido invites you to swim and take boat trips. In winter, ski areas such as Sudelfeld or Zahmer Kaiser as well as numerous cross-country ski trails are available. Cultural highlights such as the Thierseer Passionsspiele or a visit to the Festung Kufstein are easily accessible. The quiet, unspoilt location is suitable for both families and couples seeking relaxation.
